title: Detailed mobile phone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='screenGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4fc3f7'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#29b6f6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0288d1'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#78909c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#546e7a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='screenShine' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b3e5fc' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
      <stop offset='40%' stop-color='#b3e5fc' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Phone body / case -->
  <rect x='25' y='8' width='50' height='84' rx='8' ry='8' fill='#37474f' stroke='#607d8b' stroke-width='1'/>
  <rect x='27' y='10' width='46' height='80' rx='6' ry='6' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- Screen -->
  <rect x='31' y='18' width='38' height='56' rx='1' ry='1' fill='url(#screenGrad)'/>
  <rect x='31' y='18' width='38' height='56' rx='1' ry='1' fill='url(#screenShine)'/>

  <!-- Screen content: app icons -->
  <rect x='35' y='23' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffca28'/>
  <rect x='45' y='23' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#66bb6a'/>
  <rect x='55' y='23' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ef5350'/>
  <rect x='35' y='33' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ab47bc'/>
  <rect x='45' y='33' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ff7043'/>
  <rect x='55' y='33' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#26c6da'/>
  <rect x='35' y='43' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffee58'/>
  <rect x='45' y='43' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#8d6e63'/>
  <rect x='55' y='43' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ec407a'/>

  <!-- Screen status bar -->
  <rect x='34' y='19' width='10' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <rect x='58' y='19' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e0e0e0'/>

  <!-- Home bar / dock -->
  <rect x='42' y='66' width='16' height='2' rx='1' fill='#80deea'/>

  <!-- Speaker grille -->
  <rect x='42' y='12' width='16' height='2' rx='1' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='11' r='0.8' fill='#90a4ae'/>

  <!-- Front camera -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='12' r='1.5' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='12' r='0.7' fill='#0277bd'/>

  <!-- Side buttons -->
  <rect x='24' y='25' width='2' height='8' rx='1' fill='#78909c'/>
  <rect x='24' y='37' width='2' height='6' rx='1' fill='#78909c'/>
  <rect x='74' y='28' width='2' height='12' rx='1' fill='#78909c'/>

  <!-- Home button (old style) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='4.5' fill='#455a64' stroke='#78909c' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='81' width='5' height='1.5' rx='0.7' fill='#90a4ae'/>

  <!-- Bottom speaker -->
  <rect x='38' y='88' width='6' height='1.5' rx='0.7' fill='#37474f'/>
  <rect x='46' y='88' width='6' height='1.5' rx='0.7' fill='#37474f'/>

  <!-- Headphone jack indicator -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='89' r='2' fill='#263238' stroke='#546e7a' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='89' r='1' fill='#37474f'/>
</svg>
